emails.purpose: Editorial query, not an article submission or exclusivity agreement
emails.subject: Contributor query: keeping candidate rediscovery evidence current
emails.body:
Hello RecruitingDaily editorial team,

I’m Noah Jiang, founder of Hirelix, a personal AI recruiting assistant. Your contributor guidelines invite questions at this address, so I’m checking whether the following vendor-neutral article would fit your editorial calendar:

“Candidate rediscovery needs an evidence refresh, not another ranking.”

The practical angle: when reusing a candidate record for a new brief, separate dated evidence from current interest, record which client/role a piece of feedback belongs to, and keep unresolved questions visible in the recommendation. I would use an explicitly fictional example and give readers a reusable evidence-and-questions checklist.

This would contain no product links, demo pitch, customer claims or invented performance figures. My vendor affiliation would be disclosed in the author bio. If the topic fits, please send your current length requirements and editorial process before I prepare a submission.

Best,
Noah Jiang
Founder, Hirelix
https://hirelix.online

If this query is not relevant, reply “opt out” and I will not follow up.
Mailing address: {{MAILING_ADDRESS_REQUIRED_BEFORE_SEND}}

emails.body:
Hello Celoria team,

Your contact page lists this inbox for partnerships and business inquiries. I’m Noah, founder of Hirelix, and I’m looking for recruiting practitioners willing to give candid feedback on a new AI recruiting assistant.

Hirelix works with a recruiter’s own CVs, role briefs and notes: compare candidates against a brief, keep evidence and open questions visible, and prepare a client recommendation. Saved records can be used in later conversations; preparing an email does not send it.

Would this be relevant to whoever handles recruiting tools at Celoria? A concrete first test is one role and two or three anonymized CVs you are authorized to use. There is a 7-day, 200-credit trial with no card required; no call or purchase is necessary.

Product: https://hirelix.online/?utm_source=celoria&utm_medium=partnership&utm_campaign=founder_launch_20261030

If someone tries it, I’d value a reply naming the first place the comparison or recommendation falls short.

Best,
Noah Jiang
Founder, Hirelix
